      Why Horween?

      Our search for quality and craftsmanship brought us to Horween Leather Company, one of the oldest continually operated tanneries in the United States. Horween’s commitment to detail matches our own dedication to quality and craftsmanship. Their leather is top quality and develops a rich, lustrous patina with time. Learn more.
